newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Unibanco research head may join Brazil cenbank.
newsitem.headline: Unibanco research head may join Brazil cenbank.

text.p: The head of research at private bank Unibanco, Demostenes Madureira de Pinho Neto, has been invited to become the next international affairs director of the Brazilian Central Bank, national Globo television reported.
Globo television said in its breakfast news program that Madureira de Pinho was expected to decide Friday whether or not to accept the invitation.
The bank's international affairs director represents the monetary authority abroad and presides over Brazil's foreign debt progam.

The local media has widely reported this week that Gustavo Franco, the outgoing international affairs director who will assume the Central Bank presidency next week, had wanted to give the job to his childhood friend, economist Luiz Paulo Marinho Nunes.

But Globo said the government had discovered that Nunes' current employer, German grains trader Alfred C Toepfer, was suing the Central Bank and his appointment might therefore constitute a conflict of interest.
Madureira de Pinho has had previous government experience, having worked in the Finance Ministry's economic policy department under former president Itamar Franco.
Current president Fernando Henrique Cardoso was finance minister at the time.
